test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum invested at compound interest amounts to Rs. 8,000 in 4 years and Rs. 8,400 in 5 years, interest being compounded yearly. What will be the amount of the same sum at the end of the 6th year?
solution:
**Given;**

A sum of the amount becomes 8000 in 4 years and 8400 in 5 years at compound interest

**Formula used:**

At compound interest, the final amount = P(1+(r)/(100) )^n

Where, P = The sum of the amount

r = Rate of interest

n = Time (years)

**Calculation:**

Here, Rs. 8000 becomes Rs. 84000 at compound interest in one year.

Let, the rate of interest = R

So, 8400
